title: Stopped queue entry
summary: A deliberate hold waits across head changes until fresh arming or queue entry. A real stop reports failed disarming and names the hold command before correction and re-entry. A missing-check stop requires readable protection rules naming a required check absent from the head; all reported checks keep an armed BLOCKED landing admitted. Unreadable rules report required_checks_unreadable and restoring read access; push advice requires a named missing check after the workflow wait grace.
